turns.customer: I'd like to return the Swift 30 daypack from order #1043. It's unused and still in the packaging. Can I submit a return?
turns.reply: Yes, you can return the Swift 30 daypack from order #1043 since it is unused and in its original packaging. You have until October 5, 2026 to submit the return. To start the return, you can generate and use the return label available in your account. Once the warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued to your original payment method, usually within 5 business days.
